title: Bounded causal candidate, not a confirmed law
claim: X may causally affect Y if observed confounder Z is controlled and temporal order is respected.
assumptions: Z is observed and measured before treatment
the claim must not exceed the max_allowed_claim_level returned by CausalGate
measurable_predictions: After controlling for Z, changes in X should precede measurable changes in Y within the specified window.
negative_controls: N should not change when X changes.
placebo_tests: Future X must not predict past Y.
sensitivity_checks: Estimate how strong an unobserved confounder must be to erase the effect.
data_requirements: time ordered X, Y, Z observations
test_plan: Submit the hypothesis to CausalGate; run SCM-ID; only then allow estimation. Public language must obey max_allowed_claim_level.
